_readme: Template for your private owner-rules.json. Copy it to the phone, fill it in, and import it through Settings > Sovereign SMS > Import. Keep the filled copy out of Git. Keys starting with _ are comments and are ignored. Leave out any section (rules, guard, flags, templates) to keep what the app already has.

rules._readme: Notification rules. Actions: ALERT, SILENT, HELD. Days: 1=Mon..7=Sun. Minutes from midnight: 1320 = 22:00.
rules._quietHoursCategories: Leave out PERSONAL so personal contacts ring through quiet hours.
rules._priorityAddresses: Numbers that always alert. Example uses a fictional 555 number; replace it.
rules._schedules: Schedule rules, checked after quiet hours in list order. Precedence: one-time codes and break-through keywords > priority and personal > thread mute > focus > quiet hours and schedules > unknown senders and quiet keywords. Days 1=Mon..7=Sun; minutes from midnight; an end before the start crosses midnight; start == end means all day. categories: PERSONAL, PROFESSIONAL, UNKNOWN. action: SILENT, HELD or ALERT. Both examples ship disabled.

guard._readme: Warns above the composer when a draft contains this. regex=false means plain text, case-insensitive.
guard.name: Protected term

guard._readme: Pair rule: warns only when both appear in the same draft.
guard.name: Price next to a term

guard._readme: PAIR_MATCH with a window: warns when the pair term is in the draft and the first term was in one of the thread's last N messages.
guard.name: Term after earlier mention

guard._readme: CONTEXT_GUARD: only applies when the thread's card stage is listed. Stages: NEW, INFO_REQUESTED, VERIFICATION_PENDING, VERIFIED, REGULAR, DECLINED.
guard.name: Sensitive text to unscreened thread

flags._readme: Incoming red flags: same shape as guard rules. severity: INFO, CAUTION, HIGH_RISK. Receipt actions are opt-in: silent (no sound), tag, category (PERSONAL, PROFESSIONAL, UNKNOWN; only set when the thread has none). Nothing is ever deleted, forwarded or answered. 'type' is written on export for reading and ignored on import.
flags.name: Unsolicited link

templates.title: Info request
templates.body: Thanks for reaching out. To check availability, please send your name, the time you'd like, how long, and the general area.

templates.title: Screening first
templates.body: Before we set anything up I need to complete screening. Details are REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_PROCESS.

templates.title: Verification
templates.body: Thanks, {alias}. Please send the verification we discussed when you can.

templates.title: Not available
templates.body: Thanks for asking. I'm not available for that.

templates.title: Reconfirm
templates.body: Checking we're still on for {date}, {time_window}. Reply yes to confirm.

templates.title: Follow-up
templates.body: Hi {alias}, I have some openings coming up if you'd like to set something up.
